logic_errors.issue: Subtracting an already-rounded absolute mean can overstate sample risk for large, nearly constant observations.
logic_errors.counterexample: K=1, returns [10000000000000000.0 10000000000000002.0]: expected sqrt(2), initial implementation approximately 2.

logic_errors.issue: rationalize preserves ordinary Longs; checked fixed-width reductions can overflow before the exact reference is calculated.
logic_errors.counterexample: K=1, constant returns [9223372036854775807 9223372036854775807]: mean reduction overflows; expected finite mean and zero risk.

suggestions: Add large-offset/small-dispersion and large-integral regression cases with relative or ULP-sensitive checks.
scope: Independent static review of g1-review.diff and g1-static-scan.json; no edits or experiments by reviewer.
resolution: Resolved with recorded test-first fixes. Further cancellation finding retained in review 2; final exact-arithmetic implementation approved in review 3, with parent regression and source-hash verification.
